title: A nullable intersection property can hold null despite disjoint class alternatives

ground_truth.statement: The null union member explicitly permits the null initializer, regardless of whether the DateTime and DateTimeImmutable intersection is inhabitable. No property initialization type error follows from this annotation.

provenance.derivation: Public observable property avoids unrelated unused-private-property diagnostics.

notes: Uses PHPDoc intersection syntax, not a native DNF declaration. Parentheses explicitly group the intersection so this measures null initialization rather than cross-dialect precedence parsing; the initial unparenthesized spelling caused PHPStan parse errors. An advisory about the impossible intersection is a separate policy from whether null is a valid default.
